svg.title: Autonomy Did Not Mean an Unchanging Life
svg.desc: People act: Communities could adjust activities while maintaining local authority.. Connections: Economic interaction does not automatically erase autonomy.. No frozen history: Resistance does not prove isolation or unchanged practices across centuries.
